name: renewal-notice
title: Renewal notice
for_each: select c.id, c.reference || ' ' || c.name as name from clients c where exists (select 1 from renewal_book b join cases k on k.id = b.case_id where k.client_id = c.id and b.days_to_due <= 120 and b.state not in ('lapsing on instructions','lapsed'))

sections.title: Client
sections.sql: select c.name as client, c.contact_name as attention, c.email from clients c where c.id = $1

sections.title: Rights due for renewal
sections.note: If a right is not renewed it lapses and the protection ends. Reply Renew or Let lapse for each one.
sections.sql: select b.title as right_name, b.case_kind as type, b.country, k.registration_no as number, b.classes, b.term as renewal, b.due_on, b.grace_ends_on as last_day_with_late_fee from renewal_book b join cases k on k.id = b.case_id where k.client_id = $1 and b.days_to_due <= 120 and b.state not in ('lapsing on instructions','lapsed') order by b.due_on

sections.title: Your instructions
sections.sql: select b.title as right_name, b.country, '' as renew_or_let_lapse from renewal_book b join cases k on k.id = b.case_id where k.client_id = $1 and b.days_to_due <= 120 and b.state not in ('lapsing on instructions','lapsed') order by b.due_on

name: portfolio-report
title: Your intellectual property portfolio
for_each: select c.id, c.reference || ' ' || c.name as name from clients c where exists (select 1 from cases k where k.client_id = c.id)

sections.title: Registered and in force
sections.sql: select k.title, k.kind, k.country, k.classes, k.registration_no, k.registered_on, (select min(r.due_on) from renewals r where r.case_id = k.id and r.paid_on is null) as next_renewal from cases k where k.client_id = $1 and k.status = 'registered' order by k.title, k.country

sections.title: Applications in progress
sections.sql: select k.title, k.kind, k.country, k.application_no, k.filed_on, k.status, (select min(d.due_on) from deadlines d where d.case_id = k.id and d.closed_on is null and d.statutory) as next_deadline from cases k where k.client_id = $1 and k.status in ('drafting','filed','examination','accepted') order by k.filed_on

sections.title: Lapsed, abandoned or withdrawn
sections.sql: select k.title, k.kind, k.country, k.status from cases k where k.client_id = $1 and k.status in ('lapsed','abandoned','withdrawn') order by k.title

sections.title: Missed
sections.sql: select case_ref, client, attorney, deadline, due_on, -days_left as days_overdue from docket where statutory and days_left < 0 and $1::uuid is not null order by due_on

sections.title: Next 60 days
sections.sql: select case_ref, client, attorney, country, deadline, due_on, days_left, case when statutory then 'statutory' else 'watch' end as type, coalesce(verified_by, 'NOT CHECKED') as checked_by from docket where days_left between 0 and 60 and $1::uuid is not null order by due_on
